---
description: Step 8 - Generate PR Summary for Approval
---
Review all Git changes across the workspace and generate `PR_SUMMARY.md` containing the required 5 sections:
1. Summary (2-3 sentence overview)
2. Changes Made (bulleted list of modified/added files)
3. Test Evidence (pytest output summary)
4. Known Limitations (out-of-scope boundaries)
5. Reviewer Checklist (tick-list for PR approval)
